Name: Name
2 to 6 digits, 600 is reserved for the e: 2 to 6 digits, 600 is reserved for the echo test
At least 4 characters. Leave empty to ge: At least 4 characters. Leave empty to generate one
hint_password: Passwords need at least 4 characters - a shorter one is marked red and blocks saving. Passwords are stored encrypted. Asterisk only gets an MD5 hash of them. An empty password is generated randomly when the instance starts.
hint_pinning: WebRTC requires an encrypted connection (WSS). Apps check the self-signed certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint. Browsers must accept it once: open the test page and confirm the security warning.
Host names and IP addresses in the certi: Host names and IP addresses in the certificate
help_cert_hosts: Under these addresses the clients connect to Asterisk
confirm_regenerate: The fingerprint changes. All apps and browsers have to accept the new certificate again. Save the settings afterwards.
Run Asterisk in Docker (managed by this: Run Asterisk in Docker (managed by this adapter)
help_docker: The container uses host networking (Linux only). Asterisk is installed into it on the first start, which takes a few minutes.
Stop the container when the instance sto: Stop the container when the instance stops
hint_external: Asterisk runs elsewhere on this host: mount the configuration directory to /etc/asterisk/iobroker and include the generated files. See README.
help_config_dir: The generated files are written here and mounted into the container. Empty = data directory of the instance
Must be greater than the start port: Must be greater than the start port
help_codecs: Browsers support Opus, G.722 and G.711. SIP endpoints never get Opus. Opus is used only if the module is available
help_video_codecs: Video is passed through, not transcoded: both parties need a common codec. Browsers support VP8 and H.264. Empty = audio only
help_stun: Only required if clients connect from outside the LAN
help_external_address: Public IP or DNS name for clients behind NAT (optional)
help_ice_denylist: Comma separated, e.g. Docker networks. Must not contain your LAN
help_asterisk_log: Errors become errors, warnings warnings, notices info and everything else debug in the ioBroker log. Shown only if the log level of the instance allows it
help_sip_trace: Only for troubleshooting registration and calls: every SIP message appears as debug. Requires "Plus call flow" or "Everything"
hint_cameras: The adapter fetches the pictures of these cameras - also with password or API key, which a browser in vis cannot do - and writes them into intercom.X.cameras.<name>.image. Select this state in the phone widget under "Camera picture from state". During a call the picture is updated fast, otherwise slowly. UniFi Protect: https://<console IP>/proxy/protect/integration/v1/cameras/<camera ID>/snapshot with an API key (UniFi OS → Settings → Control Plane → Integrations).
